name: VitaBench
intro: VitaBench是一个旨在评估LLM代理在真实世界交互任务中表现的基准测试。它通过模拟外卖、店内消费和在线旅游服务等日常应用场景，构建了一个包含66种工具的复杂仿真环境。该基准测试包含100个跨场景任务和300个单场景任务，旨在评估代理处理复杂信息、利用多样资源和管理动态用户交互的能力。
scale: 100个跨场景任务, 300个单场景任务
intro_en: VitaBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate LLM agents' performance in real-world interactive tasks. It simulates everyday application scenarios such as food delivery, in-store dining, and online travel services, creating a complex simulation environment with 66 tools. The benchmark includes 100 cross-scenario tasks and 300 single-scenario tasks, aiming to assess agents' abilities to handle complex information, utilize diverse resources, and manage dynamic user interactions.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.26490v2, Sections 3.2-3.3 (pp.4-6) and Section 4.1 (p.6); official repository: https://github.com/meituan-longcat/vitabench. The diagram is pinned to paper v2; later repository evaluator/database/result updates are maintenance drift, not paper evidence.. VitaBench models three real application domains with 66 tools, explicit pre/postconditions, dependency graphs, and a user simulator that progressively reveals needs. User profiles, composite requests, real/synthetic environment data, and human rubrics feed repeated trial-and-human-acceptance cycles that retain 400 tasks: 100 cross-domain and 300 single-domain (100 each for Delivery, In-store, and OTA). Evaluation runs an agent against the user simulator and tools until ###STOP### or failure, scores overlapping trajectory windows into persistent rubric states, and repeats each task four times. Strict success requires every rubric item satisfied; the paper reports Avg@4, Pass@4, and Pass^4.
